scope: Theorem 7.1 (Congruence distribution) of the manuscript “Prime Predecessors with an Even Number of Prime Factors” (preprints/Prime-Predecessors-with-an-Even-Number-of-Prime-Factors-September-17-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 011 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ee2d8f79198dd5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed 0 < ϑ < 1/2 and D > 0, X d≤xϑ d odd and squarefree |r(d)| ≪ϑ,D xL−D + XAL−18 . The constants may depend on the fixed weight geometry and Ψ, but not on any later proxy precision. No effective bound on the threshold for x is asserted.
